row.name: Argan Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=30 breakdowns=7 bursts_in_base=2 giveback=1.77 tightness=0.83 base_volume_vs_leg=1.16 base_volume_vs_avg=1.04
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 30 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20; 7 4% breakdowns inside the base; the base gave back 1.77 of the leg

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close -7.4% vs its 20-SMA, -24.5% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 4 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)
first leg of 22.2% in 6 sessions: his '15% plus in 10 days or less'

claude.reason: The chart shows AGX in a clear multi-month downtrend from ~$800 to ~$390, with the shaded base spanning 30 sessions of persistent lower highs and lower lows — this is a downtrend, not a consolidation. The base has 7 four-percent breakdowns and gave back 177% of the prior leg, and the burst bar itself shows no range expansion (RE FAIL: only 0.2x the prior 5-bar range). Volume on the burst day was actually lower than the prior session, and prior breakouts in this name worked only 1 of 4 times.
claude.key_risk: The stock is in a structural downtrend with all major moving averages sloping sharply lower, meaning any bounce is likely to be sold into overhead supply from the entire base.
claude.entry_note: Skip regardless of open — the base failure alone (30 sessions, 7 breakdowns, 177% giveback) disqualifies this setup before price action at the open is even considered.

row.summary: AGX: +1.8% on 0.9× volume out of a base 40.4% deep. skip 8.0, 5 of 6 criteria.
